headline: OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158 exploited in the wild; Chainalysis breach exposed all customers' credentials; Zyxel GS1900 patch bypassed

bullets.text: Update: BleepingComputer now reports the Chainalysis breach exposed credentials for all customers; the company shut down key services. DigiCert (customer info, identity documents) and DreamHost (FTP logins, webmail sessions) breaches remain on the board.

Still active, OpenSSH, 5 outlets: CVE-2026-123158 is exploited in the wild hours after disclosure. Related: OpenSSH's emergency fix for long passwords bypassing SSH auth on Alpine Linux, which also reaches routers. SITCON holds at 3 (ELEVATED); last 7 days at 0.7x the 90-day average.

Still active, Zyxel GS1900, 4 outlets and top story: Zyxel's fix did not block the in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441) used to hack nearly 1,000 switches, which allows root command execution. D-Link separately warned of multiple zero-days in DGS-3130 Series switches.

CISA KEV: WordPress Core CVE-2026-119977 (TOCTOU race, exploited for RCE) is due today, 2026-11-06. Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935 is due 2026-11-13; Apple CVE-2024-27834, used to deliver info-stealing malware, is due 2026-11-18.

Still active, supply chain: cPGuard autoupdate was hijacked in the OpsShield attack to serve malicious updates (3 outlets). The NIKKE PC game launcher was hacked to spread remote-access and data-stealing malware.
Critical infrastructure: the UK warned its critical infrastructure faces grave risk, and FBI and CISA warned of attacks on refrigeration and cooling systems, urging operators to harden them now.

actions: Patch OpenSSH on every internet-facing host now for CVE-2026-123158; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for exploitation.
Chainalysis, DigiCert and DreamHost customers: reset passwords, rotate API keys and FTP credentials, and watch for phishing.
Treat Zyxel GS1900 and D-Link DGS-3130 switches as exposed: restrict management access, check for compromise, apply fixes as they ship.
Patch WordPress Core for CVE-2026-119977 today (KEV due 2026-11-06); schedule Ivanti and Apple KEV fixes before their due dates.
cPGuard users: check servers for malicious updates and rotate credentials; NIKKE launcher users should scan for malware.
Operators of refrigeration and cooling systems: review exposure and apply the FBI/CISA hardening guidance now.
